name: Spectra AI — Definitive Mark
title: Spectra AI Definitive Brand Mark
rationale:
I have designed the definitive brand mark for **Spectra AI**, engineered for enterprise credibility and high-fidelity precision.

### Design Rationale
*   **Symbolic Fusion**: The mark seamlessly integrates three core concepts: the **glass prism** (Spectra), the **document silhouette** (Requirements), and the **integrated checkmark** (Audit Verification).
*   **Precision Optics**: I used a tight, 6-band spectral fan moving from cyan through violet to amber, avoiding a generic rainbow in favor of a technical, refracted look that implies advanced analysis.
*   **Engineering Aesthetic**: The lockup follows a modern, minimalist direction inspired by high-tier brands like Vercel and Linear, featuring crisp 1px edges and a restrained electric cyan badge for the "AI" component.
*   **Optimal Legibility**: The horizontal lockup is balanced for premium presentations while maintaining a favicon-safe silhouette that scales effectively.

The presentation is set against a dark void background (#06080C) to maximize the contrast of the spectral bands and highlight the "clinical" precision of the engine.
